# Battery Ventures makes significant equity investment in Curve Dental

1

minute read

![print](https://gowlingwlg.com/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fbrandconnect.gowlingwlg.com%2Fm%2F214f92f53740f48c%2Foriginal%2Fprint.svg&w=64&q=75)
![download](https://gowlingwlg.com/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fbrandconnect.gowlingwlg.com%2Fm%2Fb02c2aa13eb865e%2Foriginal%2Fdownload.svg&w=48&q=75)

On February 8, 2018, Battery Ventures announced a significant equity investment in Curve Dental.

Curve Dental provides web-based dental software and related services to dental practices within the United States and Canada. The company is privately-held, with offices in Orem, Utah and Calgary, Alberta.

Battery Ventures invests in cutting-edge, category-defining businesses in markets including software and services, Web infrastructure, consumer Internet, mobile and industrial technologies. The firm backs companies at stages ranging from seed to private equity and invests globally from offices in Boston, the San Francisco Bay Area, London and Israel.

Gowling WLG advised Battery Ventures with respect to the Canadian components of this investment with a team that was led by Lorne Segal and that included Martin Mix, Julien Bourgeois and Garrett Hamel (corporate); Melanie Polowin (employment); and Carole Chouinard (tax).
